/*

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0130_GET_SCHEDULED_RECIEPT_INFORMATION]
	  @p_division_id		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @p_plan_group_id	    NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @p_plant_site_id		NVARCHAR(MAX)
    , @p_item_id_child		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @p_valid_yn			NVARCHAR(MAX)
    , @p_from_date          NVARCHAR(MAX)


AS
BEGIN
	
  SET NOCOUNT ON; 
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

-- 파라미터로 받을 값 변수  
  DECLARE @v_division_id		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_division_id
  DECLARE @v_plan_group_id		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_plan_group_id
  DECLARE @v_plant_site_id		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_plant_site_id
  DECLARE @v_item_id_child		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_item_id_child
  DECLARE @v_valid_yn		    NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_valid_yn

 -- 	insert test2 (col1, col3)
	--values('SCP0130_GET_SCHEDULED_RECIEPT_INFORMATION'
	--		,'@v_division_id^'+@v_division_id
	--		+'^@p_plan_group_id^'+@p_plan_group_id
	--		+'^@v_plant_site_id^'+@v_plant_site_id
	--		+'^@p_item_id_child^'+@p_item_id_child
	--		+'^@v_valid_ynn^'+@v_valid_yn
	--		+'^@p_from_date^'+@p_from_date 
 --     )

  SELECT DISTINCT a.DIVISION_ID
        ,a.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
        ,a.PLANT_SITE_ID
        ,a.ITEM_ID_CHILD
        , CONVERT(date, a.TO_YYYYMMDD, 112) AS TO_YYYYMMDD
        ,a.TO_EXPC_QTY
        ,a.VALUE_DESCRIPTION
        ,a.VALID_YN
        ,a.CREATED_BY
        ,a.CREATION_DATE
        ,a.LAST_UPDATED_BY
        ,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        ,a.DIVISION_ID+ '|' + a.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID+ '|' + a.PLANT_SITE_ID+ '|' +  A.ITEM_ID_CHILD +'|' +  a.ITEM_ID_CHILD + '|' +  a.TO_YYYYMMDD  + '|'  + CAST(a.TO_EXPC_QTY AS nvarchar(30)) + '|' +  A.VALID_YN+ '|' + A.VALUE_DESCRIPTION    AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
    FROM DBO.SCP_OPMZ_SCHEDULED_RECIEPT_INFORMATION a  with(nolock)
    INNER JOIN SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM C 
           ON  A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
           AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = C.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID_CHILD = C.ITEM_ID_CHILD
           AND C.VALID_YN ='Y'
    INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT '%'+token+'%' tst FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_item_id_child,',') ) b
            ON a.ITEM_ID_CHILD  like  b.tst 

    WHERE 1=1
    AND  A.TO_YYYYMMDD >= @p_from_date 
    AND ( ( @v_division_id   IS NULL OR @v_division_id = '' )   OR a.DIVISION_ID     IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_division_id  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_plant_site_id IS NULL OR @v_plant_site_id = '' ) OR a.PLANT_SITE_ID   IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_plant_site_id  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_valid_yn      IS NULL OR @v_valid_yn   = '' )    OR a.VALID_YN        IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_valid_yn  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_plan_group_id IS NULL OR @v_plan_group_id = '' ) OR a.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_plan_group_id  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_item_id_child IS NULL OR @v_item_id_child = '' ) OR a.ITEM_ID_CHILD   IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_item_id_child  ,',')) )
  
END

,@v_value_description
                      ,@v_valid_yn
                      ,@v_last_updated_by
                      ,GETDATE()
                      ,@v_last_updated_by
                      ,GETDATE()
                )

			END
			ELSE IF( @v_active_flag ='M' )
			BEGIN

                UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_SCHEDULED_RECIEPT_INFORMATION
                SET DIVISION_ID           = @v_division_id
                   ,OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID       = @v_opmz_plan_gr_id
                   ,PLANT_SITE_ID         = @v_plant_site_id
                   ,ITEM_ID_CHILD         = @v_item_id_child
                   ,TO_YYYYMMDD           = @v_to_yyyymmdd
				   ,TO_EXPC_QTY           = @v_to_expc_qty
                   ,VALUE_DESCRIPTION     = @v_value_description
                   ,VALID_YN              = @v_valid_yn
                   ,LAST_UPDATED_BY	      = @v_last_updated_by
                   ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE      = SYSDATETIME()
                WHERE DIVISION_ID           = @v_pre_division_id
                AND   OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID       = @v_pre_opmz_plan_gr_id
                AND   PLANT_SITE_ID         = @v_pre_plant_site_id
		        AND   ITEM_ID_CHILD         = @v_pre_item_id_child
				AND   TO_YYYYMMDD           = @v_pre_to_yyyymmdd
				;

			END
			--삭제기능 추가 (2025-07-16)
			ELSE IF(@v_active_flag ='D')
			BEGIN
				
				DELETE SCP_OPMZ_SCHEDULED_RECIEPT_INFORMATION
                WHERE DIVISION_ID           = @v_pre_division_id
                AND   OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID       = @v_pre_opmz_plan_gr_id
                AND   PLANT_SITE_ID         = @v_pre_plant_site_id
                AND   ITEM_ID_CHILD         = @v_pre_item_id_child
				AND   TO_YYYYMMDD           = @v_pre_to_yyyymmdd

			END

		END

		SET @v_log_type = 'END';
		SET @v_log_message = '########## END of procedure ##########';
		SET @v_description = '';
		SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();
		EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;
			
		COMMIT TRAN;
			
		-- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
		SELECT  'S' AS result_code,  @max_loop_cnt AS result_cnt ;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF (XACT_STATE() <> 0) ROLLBACK TRAN; --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO scm_sys_log_batch (program_name
											,log_type
											,log_count
											,log_message
											,description
											,event_date
											,creation_date
											,created_by
											,last_update_date
											,last_updated_by)
			VALUES (ERROR_PROCEDURE()
					,'ERROR'
					,NULL
					,ERROR_MESSAGE()
					,NULL
					,SYSDATETIME()
					,SYSDATETIME()
					,ERROR_PROCEDURE()
					,SYSDATETIME()
					,ERROR_PROCEDURE());

			--IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			--	COMMIT WORK;

		END;

		-- error코드, errror 메시지 반환

 * Program ID   : SCP0130_GET_SEARCH_INFO
 * Description  : 선행생산 일수 (PRECEDE / SAFETY STOCK DAY)

 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *===================================================================================================

 *
 */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0130_GET_SEARCH_INFO]
	 @p_division_id		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_site_id         NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	
    SET NOCOUNT ON; 
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
 
 	DECLARE @v_division_id   NVARCHAR(200)   = @p_division_id
	DECLARE @v_site_id       NVARCHAR(200)   = @p_site_id
     -- 참조 기간 및 기준일자 정보 변수
    DECLARE @v_from_yyyymmdd		NVARCHAR(8)		= NULL	-- 당주 월요일 (plan_start_yyyymmdd) 
    DECLARE @v_to_yyyymmdd			NVARCHAR(8)		= NULL	-- horizon_end_date ?

	--1. Plan Group 정보 
	select OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID	AS CODE
		, OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME	AS NAME
		, DIVISION_ID
	from SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M with(nolock)
	WHERE 1=1
	 AND VALID_YN='Y'
	


	--2. 재고 SCM SITE ID 
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'	
	AND A.DIVISION_ID != '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
		ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] A
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
	ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
	
  

   -- 3. STAGE 최적화 
   SELECT M.SEGMENT1  AS DIVISION_ID
         ,M.SEGMENT3 AS CODE
         ,M.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
   FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
   WHERE M.LOOKUP_TYPE LIKE 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_DEF_STAGE'
   AND   M.VALID_YN='Y'
   -- AND   M.SEGMENT1 ='81' --DIVISION_NO
	

	-- 4. TYPE (COVER_DAY_TYPE : MIN/MAX) 호출
	SELECT M.SEGMENT1 AS CODE
		,M.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
	  	-- ,M.DISPLAY_SEQ
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 	 'COVER_DAY_TYPE'
    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ
  
    -- 5. valid YN
    SELECT M.SEGMENT1 AS CODE
		,M.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
		-- ,M.DISPLAY_SEQ
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 	'DM_YN' -- 'DEFAULT_FLAG'
    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ

	--6.Item 정보(Validation 체크용)
	--SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
	--             , ITEM_ID
	--FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN WITH(NOLOCK)

	-- 6. MATERIAL ID/ Vitual BOM에서 생성한 Child ID
	SELECT M.ITEM_ID_CHILD AS CODE
	      ,M.ITEM_ID_CHILD AS NAME
		  ,M.DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
	      ,M.SCM_SITE_ID
	FROM SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM  M WITH(NOLOCK)
    -- WHERE M.DIVISION_ID=@p_division_id
     
   
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0130_GET_VIRTUAL_BOM]
	  @p_division_id		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @p_plan_group_id	    NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @p_scm_site_id		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @p_item_id			NVARCHAR(MAX)
    , @p_item_id_child		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @p_valid_yn			NVARCHAR(MAX)


AS
BEGIN
	
  SET NOCOUNT ON; 
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

-- 파라미터로 받을 값 변수  
  DECLARE @v_division_id		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_division_id
  DECLARE @v_plan_group_id		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_plan_group_id
  DECLARE @v_scm_site_id		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_scm_site_id
  DECLARE @v_item_id		    NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_item_id
  DECLARE @v_item_id_child		NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_item_id_child
  DECLARE @v_valid_yn		    NVARCHAR(200)	= @p_valid_yn

  SELECT a.DIVISION_ID
        ,a.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
        ,a.SCM_SITE_ID
        ,a.ITEM_ID
        ,a.ITEM_ID_CHILD
        , CONVERT(date, a.TO_YYYYMMDD, 112) AS TO_YYYYMMDD
        ,a.TO_EXPC_QTY
        ,a.VALUE_DESCRIPTION
        ,a.VALID_YN
        ,a.CREATED_BY
        ,a.CREATION_DATE
        ,a.LAST_UPDATED_BY
        ,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        ,a.DIVISION_ID+ '|' + a.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID+ '|' + a.SCM_SITE_ID+ '|' + a.ITEM_ID + '|' + a.ITEM_ID_CHILD + '|' +  a.TO_YYYYMMDD  + '|' + a.TO_EXPC_QTY + '|' +  VALID_YN+ '|' + VALUE_DESCRIPTION    AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
    FROM DBO.SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM a  with(nolock)
    INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT '%'+token+'%' tst FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_item_id,',') ) b
            ON a.ITEM_ID  like  b.tst 

    WHERE 1=1
    AND ( ( @v_division_id   IS NULL OR @v_division_id = '' )   OR a.DIVISION_ID     IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_division_id  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_scm_site_id   IS NULL OR @v_scm_site_id = '' )   OR a.SCM_SITE_ID     IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_scm_site_id  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @p_valid_yn      IS NULL OR @v_valid_yn   = '' )    OR a.VALID_YN        IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_valid_yn  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_plan_group_id IS NULL OR @v_plan_group_id = '' ) OR a.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_plan_group_id  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_item_id       IS NULL OR @v_item_id = '' )       OR a.ITEM_ID         IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_item_id  ,',')) )
    AND ( ( @v_item_id_child IS NULL OR @v_item_id_child = '' ) OR a.ITEM_ID_CHILD   IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@v_item_id_child  ,',')) )
  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0130_GET_SEARCH_INFO]

	,@p_site_id         NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	
    SET NOCOUNT ON; 
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
 
 	DECLARE @v_division_id   NVARCHAR(200)   = @p_division_id
	DECLARE @v_site_id       NVARCHAR(200)   = @p_site_id
     -- 참조 기간 및 기준일자 정보 변수
    DECLARE @v_from_yyyymmdd		NVARCHAR(8)		= NULL	-- 당주 월요일 (plan_start_yyyymmdd) 
    DECLARE @v_to_yyyymmdd			NVARCHAR(8)		= NULL	-- horizon_end_date ?

	--1. Plan Group 정보 
	select OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID	AS CODE
		, OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME	AS NAME
		, DIVISION_ID
	from SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M with(nolock)
	WHERE 1=1
	 AND VALID_YN='Y'
	


	--2. 재고 SCM SITE ID 
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'	
	AND A.DIVISION_ID != '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
		ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] A
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
	ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
	
  

   -- 3. STAGE 최적화 
   SELECT M.SEGMENT1  AS DIVISION_ID
         ,M.SEGMENT3 AS CODE
         ,M.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
   FROM dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
   WHERE M.LOOKUP_TYPE LIKE 'OPMZ_STAGE_CD'
--   FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
--   WHERE M.LOOKUP_TYPE LIKE 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_DEF_STAGE'
   AND   M.VALID_YN='Y'
   -- AND   M.SEGMENT1 ='81' --DIVISION_NO
	

	-- 4. TYPE (COVER_DAY_TYPE : MIN/MAX) 호출
	SELECT M.SEGMENT1 AS CODE
		,M.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
	  	-- ,M.DISPLAY_SEQ
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 	 'COVER_DAY_TYPE'
    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ
  
    -- 5. valid YN
    SELECT M.SEGMENT1 AS CODE
		,M.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
		-- ,M.DISPLAY_SEQ
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 	'DM_YN' -- 'DEFAULT_FLAG'
    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ

	--6.Item 정보(Validation 체크용)
	--SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
	--             , ITEM_ID
	--FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN WITH(NOLOCK)

	-- 6. MATERIAL ID/ Vitual BOM에서 생성한 Child ID
	SELECT DISTINCT 
	       M.ITEM_ID_CHILD AS CODE
	      ,M.ITEM_ID_CHILD AS NAME
		  ,M.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
		  ,M.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
	      ,M.SCM_SITE_ID
		  ,M.TO_YYYYMMDD
	FROM SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM  M WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE 1=1
	  AND   M.VALID_YN ='Y'
	--  AND M.DIVISION_ID=@p_division_id
     
   
END

END
				/*** Material 유효한 확인  END *****/

			END

			IF(@v_active_flag = 'I')
			BEGIN

				MERGE INTO dbo.SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM AS a
				USING (SELECT @v_division_id     AS DIVISION_ID
                             ,@v_opmz_plan_gr_id AS  OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             ,@v_plant_site_id    AS  PLANT_SITE_ID
                             ,@v_item_id         AS  ITEM_ID
                             ,@v_item_id_child   AS  ITEM_ID_CHILD) AS b
				   ON (  a.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
				     AND A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
					 AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
					 AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
					 AND A.ITEM_ID_CHILD   = B.ITEM_ID_CHILD )
				 WHEN MATCHED THEN
				   UPDATE SET A.TO_YYYYMMDD       = @v_to_yyyymmdd
					         ,A.TO_EXPC_QTY       =@v_to_expc_qty
					         ,A.VALUE_DESCRIPTION =@v_value_description
					         ,A.VALID_YN          =@v_valid_yn
					         ,A.LAST_UPDATED_BY   =@v_last_updated_by
					         ,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE  = GETDATE()
				 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
				   INSERT(DIVISION_ID
                         ,OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                         ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                         ,ITEM_ID
                         ,ITEM_ID_CHILD
                         ,TO_YYYYMMDD
                         ,TO_EXPC_QTY
                         ,VALUE_DESCRIPTION
                         ,VALID_YN
                         ,CREATED_BY
                         ,CREATION_DATE
                         ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       ) 
					VALUES
					(
                       @v_division_id
                      ,@v_opmz_plan_gr_id
                      ,@v_plant_site_id
                      ,@v_item_id
                      ,@v_item_id_child
                      ,@v_to_yyyymmdd
					  ,@v_to_expc_qty
                      ,@v_value_description
                      ,@v_valid_yn
                      ,@v_last_updated_by
                      ,GETDATE()
                      ,@v_last_updated_by
                      ,GETDATE()
                   );
			END
			ELSE IF( @v_active_flag ='M' )
			BEGIN
			    -- 변경하려는 데이타가 key 중복일 경우 체크
				SET @cnt = 0;

				SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
				FROM SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM  WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE DIVISION_ID	= @v_division_id
				AND OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = @v_opmz_plan_gr_id
				AND PLANT_SITE_ID	    = @v_plant_site_id
				AND ITEM_ID         = @v_item_id
				AND ITEM_ID_CHILD   = @v_item_id_child
				AND NOT (
						    DIVISION_ID     = @v_pre_division_id
						AND OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = @v_pre_opmz_plan_gr_id
						AND PLANT_SITE_ID	    = @v_pre_plant_site_id
						AND ITEM_ID         = @v_pre_item_id
						AND ITEM_ID_CHILD   = @v_pre_item_id_child
						)

				IF(@cnt > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @v_err_code    = 99010 ; 
					SET @v_err_message = N' 입력 데이터 중 중복된 데이터가 있습니다.';
					THROW  @v_err_code, @v_err_message , 1; --예외발생
				END


                UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM
                SET DIVISION_ID           = @v_division_id
                   ,OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID       = @v_opmz_plan_gr_id
                   ,PLANT_SITE_ID           = @v_plant_site_id
                   ,ITEM_ID               = @v_item_id
                   ,ITEM_ID_CHILD         = @v_item_id_child
                   ,TO_YYYYMMDD           = @v_to_yyyymmdd
				   ,TO_EXPC_QTY           = @v_to_expc_qty
                   ,VALUE_DESCRIPTION     = @v_value_description
                   ,VALID_YN              = @v_valid_yn
                   ,LAST_UPDATED_BY	      = @v_last_updated_by
                   ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE      = SYSDATETIME()
                WHERE DIVISION_ID           = @v_pre_division_id
                AND   OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID       = @v_pre_opmz_plan_gr_id
                AND   PLANT_SITE_ID           = @v_pre_plant_site_id
                AND   ITEM_ID               = @v_pre_item_id

AND   ITEM_ID_CHILD         = @v_pre_item_id_child
				;
 			END
			--삭제기능 추가 (2025-07-16)
			ELSE IF(@v_active_flag ='D')
			BEGIN
				
				DELETE SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM
                WHERE DIVISION_ID           = @v_pre_division_id
                AND   OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID       = @v_pre_opmz_plan_gr_id
                AND   PLANT_SITE_ID           = @v_pre_plant_site_id
                AND   ITEM_ID               = @v_pre_item_id
                AND   ITEM_ID_CHILD         = @v_pre_item_id_child
 
			END

		END

		SET @v_log_type = 'END';
		SET @v_log_message = '########## END of procedure ##########';
		SET @v_description = '';
		SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();
		EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;
			
		COMMIT TRAN;
			
		-- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
		SELECT  'S' AS result_code,  @max_loop_cnt AS result_cnt ;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF (XACT_STATE() <> 0) ROLLBACK TRAN; --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO scm_sys_log_batch (program_name
											,log_type
											,log_count
											,log_message
											,description
											,event_date
											,creation_date
											,created_by
											,last_update_date
											,last_updated_by)
			VALUES (ERROR_PROCEDURE()
					,'ERROR'
					,NULL
					,ERROR_MESSAGE()
					,NULL
					,SYSDATETIME()
					,SYSDATETIME()
					,ERROR_PROCEDURE()
					,SYSDATETIME()
					,ERROR_PROCEDURE());

			--IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			--	COMMIT WORK;

		END;

		-- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
		SELECT 'F' AS result_code;
		SELECT '[' + Convert(NVARCHAR(10), ERROR_NUMBER()) + ']' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
	END CATCH;
END

   -- DECLARE @v_to_yyyymmdd			NVARCHAR(8)		= NULL	-- horizon_end_date ?

	select OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID	AS CODE
		, OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME	AS NAME
		, DIVISION_ID
	from SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M with(nolock)
	WHERE 1=1
	 AND VALID_YN='Y'

	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'	
	AND A.DIVISION_ID != '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
		ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] A
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
	ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
	
  

   -- 3. STAGE 최적화 
   SELECT M.SEGMENT1  AS DIVISION_ID
         ,M.SEGMENT3 AS CODE
         ,M.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME

	  	-- ,M.DISPLAY_SEQ
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)

    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ

		-- ,M.DISPLAY_SEQ
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 	'DM_YN' -- 'DEFAULT_FLAG'
    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ



	-- 6. MATERIAL ID/ Vitual BOM에서 생성한 Child ID

	--SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
	--             , ITEM_ID
	--FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN WITH(NOLOCK)

	SELECT T.DIVISION_ID

    FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM T WITH(NOLOCK)

 	DECLARE @v_division_id   NVARCHAR(200)   = @p_division_id
	DECLARE @v_site_id       NVARCHAR(200)   = @p_site_id

	--1. Plan Group 정보 
	select OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID	AS CODE
		, OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME	AS NAME
		, DIVISION_ID
	from SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M with(nolock)
	WHERE 1=1
	 AND VALID_YN='Y'
	


	--2. 재고 SCM SITE ID 
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'	
	AND A.DIVISION_ID != '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'	
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   SCM_MST_SITE AS A WITH(NOLOCK) 
	LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM AS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
		ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
	AND  A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
	AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] A
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
	ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
	
  

   -- 3. STAGE 최적화 
   SELECT M.SEGMENT1  AS DIVISION_ID
         ,M.SEGMENT3 AS CODE
         ,M.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
   FROM dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
   WHERE M.LOOKUP_TYPE LIKE 'OPMZ_STAGE_CD'
   AND   M.VALID_YN='Y'
	

	-- 4. TYPE (COVER_DAY_TYPE : MIN/MAX) 호출
	SELECT M.SEGMENT1 AS CODE
		,M.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 	 'COVER_DAY_TYPE'
    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ
  
    -- 5. valid YN
    SELECT M.SEGMENT1 AS CODE
		,M.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
	FROM   dbo.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 	'DM_YN' -- 'DEFAULT_FLAG'
    ORDER BY M.DISPLAY_SEQ



	-- 6. MATERIAL ID/ Vitual BOM에서 생성한 Child ID
	SELECT DISTINCT 
	       M.ITEM_ID_CHILD AS CODE
	      ,M.ITEM_ID_CHILD AS NAME
		  ,M.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
		  ,M.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
	      ,M.PLANT_SITE_ID
		  ,M.TO_YYYYMMDD
	FROM SCP_OPMZ_VIRTUAL_BOM  M WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE 1=1
	  AND   M.VALID_YN ='Y'

	-- 7.Item정보 Operation Group 조회용
	SELECT T.DIVISION_ID
	      ,T.ITEM_ID
		  ,T.OPERATION_GROUP 
    FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM T WITH(NOLOCK)


	-- 8.PLANT_SITE_BY_DIVISION
	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE 
		, SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
	FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE] A  WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
	AND    A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'
	ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
    

END
